scope: Read-only headless Chrome review of final production report. Desktop and 390px touch-emulated viewport; not a physical handset test.
method: Loaded actual third HTML video, called muted play(), waited for currentTime > 0.15, then waited 1.8 seconds and checked currentTime advanced by > 1.2 seconds. Reviewed screenshots of route section and actual decoded video frames.

capture_metadata_video.method: Actual Chrome frames with original timestamps. Four still-page holds; no speed-up or synthetic animation.

checks.visual_review: Four static baseline thumbnails are aligned in one row. Heading, description and loop status are readable. The third video shows the decoded lens scene at the correct aspect ratio; no clipping or overlapping copy.
Two-column baseline thumbnails fit the narrow viewport. Heading and copy wrap cleanly. The third video stays within the content width and visibly decodes/plays; vertical reading flow is intact.

publication_status: Not tested; local production-preview pass only.
